content.title: About
content.content: The liquid sugar substitute NFS (5022) is a zero‑calorie sweetener based on sucralose, designed for use in beverages, baking and cooking. It dissolves completely in water, leaves no aftertaste and is suitable for low‑sugar diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sucralose is about 600 times sweeter than sugar but is not metabolized by the body.
The liquid form allows precise dosing in industrial production.
The product is approved by the FDA and EFSA as safe for consumption.
It does not raise blood glucose levels, making it suitable for diabetics.
Stable at temperatures up to 200 °C, suitable for baking.

items.title: Weight management support
items.content: Zero calories help reduce overall energy intake when replacing sugar.

items.title: Blood sugar stability
items.content: Does not cause glucose spikes, beneficial for pre‑diabetic and diabetic individuals.

items.title: Dental health
items.content: Not fermented by oral bacteria, does not contribute to tooth decay.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Rare individual hypersensitivity to sucralose may occur.

items.title: Digestive tolerance
items.content: Large amounts can cause mild gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive people.

items.title: Not recommended for children under 3
items.content: Due to limited data on long‑term effects on development.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add the liquid sweetener to tea, coffee, cocktails, sauces, marinades and dough at 1 % of the weight of sugar being replaced. Stir well to ensure complete dissolution.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a tightly sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Shelf life is 24 months when stored properly.
